description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Prosperous Innkeeper and Davvol trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Davvol trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
